column5: noncomputable def prfScheme_coinsEquiv (F : ∀ n, (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool)) (E : List Bool → List Bool) (hE : PolyTimeComputable E) (hFE : ∀ n (s x : Fin n → Bool), E (pairEncode (List.ofFn s) (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn (F n s x)) (n q : ℕ) : (prfScheme F E hE hFE).gen.Coins n × (Fin (q + 1) → (prfScheme F E hE hFE).enc.Coins n) ≃ (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin (q + 1) → Fin n → Bool)

theorem prfScheme_coinsEquiv_ofFn (F : ∀ n, (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool)) (E : List Bool → List Bool) (hE : PolyTimeComputable E) (hFE : ∀ n (s x : Fin n → Bool), E (pairEncode (List.ofFn s) (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn (F n s x)) (n q : ℕ) (r : (prfScheme F E hE hFE).gen.Coins n × (Fin (q + 1) → (prfScheme F E hE hFE).enc.Coins n)) : List.ofFn (prfScheme_coinsEquiv F E hE hFE n q r).1 = List.ofFn r.1 ∧ ∀ j, List.ofFn ((prfScheme_coinsEquiv F E hE hFE n q r).2 j) = List.ofFn (r.2 j)

column4: theorem prfScheme_multiEncDist (F : ∀ n, (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool)) (E : List Bool → List Bool) (hE : PolyTimeComputable E) (hFE : ∀ n (s x : Fin n → Bool), E (pairEncode (List.ofFn s) (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn (F n s x)) (n q : ℕ) (m : Fin (q + 1) → Fin n → Bool) (r : (prfScheme F E hE hFE).gen.Coins n × (Fin (q + 1) → (prfScheme F E hE hFE).enc.Coins n)) : (prfScheme F E hE hFE).multiEncDist n q m r = encodeTuple (prfEncReal (F n) m r)
column5: theorem prfScheme_multiEncDist (F : ∀ n, (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool)) (E : List Bool → List Bool) (hE : PolyTimeComputable E) (hFE : ∀ n (s x : Fin n → Bool), E (pairEncode (List.ofFn s) (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn (F n s x)) (n q : ℕ) (m : Fin (q + 1) → Fin n → Bool) (r : (prfScheme F E hE hFE).gen.Coins n × (Fin (q + 1) → (prfScheme F E hE hFE).enc.Coins n)) : (prfScheme F E hE hFE).multiEncDist n q m r = encodeTuple (prfEncReal (F n) m (prfScheme_coinsEquiv F E hE hFE n q r))
theorem decodeOracleMove_pairEncode_false (ℓ₁ : ℕ) (x : List Bool) : decodeOracleMove ℓ₁ (pairEncode [false] x) = match decodeFin ℓ₁ x with | some y => .query y | none => .ret false
theorem decodeOracleMove_true_two (ℓ₁ : ℕ) (b : Bool) : decodeOracleMove ℓ₁ [true, b] = .ret b
theorem encodeHist_eq_histEnc {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℕ} (h : List ((Fin ℓ₁ → Bool) × (Fin ℓ₂ → Bool))) : encodeHist h = GGMRed.histEnc h
noncomputable def preComp_coinsEquiv (A : NUPPT) {pre : List Bool → List Bool} (hpre : PolyTimeComputable pre) (n : ℕ) : (A.preComp hpre).Coins n ≃ A.Coins n

theorem preComp_coinsEquiv_ofFn (A : NUPPT) {pre : List Bool → List Bool} (hpre : PolyTimeComputable pre) (n : ℕ) (r : (A.preComp hpre).Coins n) : List.ofFn (A.preComp_coinsEquiv hpre n r) = List.ofFn r

column4: theorem runAt_preComp (A : NUPPT) {pre : List Bool → List Bool} (hpre : PolyTimeComputable pre) (n : ℕ) (y : List Bool) (r : (A.preComp hpre).Coins n) : (A.preComp hpre).runAt n y r = A.runAt n (pre (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) y)) r
column5: theorem runAt_preComp (A : NUPPT) {pre : List Bool → List Bool} (hpre : PolyTimeComputable pre) (n : ℕ) (y : List Bool) (r : (A.preComp hpre).Coins n) : (A.preComp hpre).runAt n y r = A.runAt n (pre (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) y)) (A.preComp_coinsEquiv hpre n r)
theorem eq_blocks_divNat_modNat {q ℓ : ℕ} (w : Fin (q * ℓ) → Bool) (k : Fin (q * ℓ)) : w k = FunFamily.blocks q ℓ w k.divNat k.modNat
theorem prfAdv_def [Fintype K] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype O] [Fintype ρ] (F : K → I → O) (A : OracleAdversary ρ I O) : prfAdv F A = distAdv F (randomFunction I O) (oracleDist A)
theorem randomFunction_apply (I O : Type*) (f : I → O) : randomFunction I O f = f
theorem ggmBits_def (G : (Fin n → Bool) → Fin (2 * n) → Bool) : ggmBits G = ggm (splitHalves ∘ G)
theorem ggm_apply (G : S → S × S) (K : S) (x : Fin n → Bool) : ggm G K x = ggmFrom G x 0 K
theorem pairSel_false (v : S × S) : pairSel false v = v.1
theorem pairSel_true (v : S × S) : pairSel true v = v.2
theorem prefixAt_apply (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : ℕ) (k : Fin i) : prefixAt x i k = if h : k.val < n then x ⟨k, h⟩ else false
theorem splitHalves_apply_fst (z : Fin (2 * n) → Bool) (k : Fin n) : (splitHalves z).1 k = z ⟨k, by omega⟩
theorem splitHalves_apply_snd (z : Fin (2 * n) → Bool) (k : Fin n) : (splitHalves z).2 k = z ⟨n + k, by omega⟩
def ProverBounded (π : Protocol) (R : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (B : PolyExpr) : Prop
theorem ProverBounded.mono {π : Protocol} {R : List Bool → List Bool → Prop} {B B' : PolyExpr} (h : π.ProverBounded R B) (hle : ∀ n, B.eval n ≤ B'.eval n) : π.ProverBounded R B'
theorem proverBounded_iff (π : Protocol) (R : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (B : PolyExpr) : π.ProverBounded R B ↔ ∀ x y r hist, R x y → (π.P.next x y r hist).length ≤ B.eval x.length

theorem viewV_withV (π : Protocol) (V' : Strategy) (x y z : List Bool) (r : (π.withV V').ExecCoins (π.withV V').P x) : (π.withV V').viewV x y z r = ⟨x, z, List.ofFn r.2, (exec π.P V' π.verifierFirst x y z (List.ofFn r.1) (List.ofFn r.2) (π.rounds.eval x.length)).2⟩
def withV_vCoinsEquiv (π : Protocol) (V' : Strategy) (n : ℕ) : (π.withV V').V.Coins n ≃ V'.Coins n
theorem withV_vCoinsEquiv_ofFn (π : Protocol) (V' : Strategy) (n : ℕ) (r : (π.withV V').V.Coins n) : List.ofFn (π.withV_vCoinsEquiv V' n r) = List.ofFn r
theorem coinLen_eq (S : Strategy) (n : ℕ) : S.coinLen n = S.coins.eval n
theorem efficient_iff (S : Strategy) : S.Efficient ↔ ∃ A : NUPPT, A.Uniform ∧ S.coins = A.coins ∧ ∀ x z r hist, S.next x z r hist = (ofNUPPT A).next x z r hist
theorem View.encode_mk (x z r : List Bool) (received : List (List Bool)) : View.encode ⟨x, z, r, received⟩ = pairEncode (pairEncode x z) (pairEncode r (Strategy.encodeMsgs received))
